title: Evidence-Aligned Entity Verification for Hallucination Detection in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.08267v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hallucination detection is crucial for large language models (LLMs), as hallucinated content creates significant barriers in applications requiring factual accuracy. Current detection methods mainly depend on internal signals like uncertainty and self-consistency checks, using the model's pre-trained knowledge to identify unreliable outputs. However, pre-trained knowledge may become outdated and has coverage limitations, especially for specialized or recent information. To address these limitations, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has emerged as a promising solution by retrieving relevant evidence at inference time, grounding outputs beyond the model's parametric knowledge. In this paper, we target a critical and practical learning problem RAG-based hallucination detection (RHD), where RAG is employed to enhance hallucination detection by addressing information updating challenges. translated_title: 面向检索增强生成中幻觉检测的证据对齐实体验证
translated_abstract: 幻觉检测对于大型语言模型（LLMs）至关重要，因为幻觉内容在需要事实准确性的应用中造成了重大障碍。当前的检测方法主要依赖于内部信号，如不确定性和自一致性检查，利用模型的预训练知识来识别不可靠的输出。然而，预训练知识可能变得过时且存在覆盖范围上的局限性，尤其是对于专业化或最新的信息。为了解决这些局限性，检索增强生成（RAG）已成为一种有前景的解决方案，它在推理时检索相关证据，使输出基于超越模型参数化知识的信息。在本文中，我们针对一个关键且实用的学习问题——基于RAG的幻觉检测（RHD），其中利用RAG通过解决信息更新挑战来增强幻觉检测。为了解决RHD问题，我们提出了一种新颖的方法——证据对齐实体验证（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了基于RAG的幻觉检测（RHD）这一新问题，并提出证据对齐实体验证方法，利用推理时检索的外部证据来克服预训练知识过时和覆盖范围有限的局限，从而更准确地检测大语言模型的幻觉输出。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces the new problem of RAG-based hallucination detection (RHD) and proposes an Evidence-Aligned Entity Verification method that leverages externally retrieved evidence at inference time to overcome the limitations of outdated and coverage-limited pre-trained knowledge for more accurate hallucination detection in LLMs.
